questions.question:
Select the option that represents the letters that, when sequentially placed from left to right in the blanks below, will complete the letter series.

P _ _ O N _ L B _ N P L _ O _ P L _ _ N

options.text: L B P O B N B O
L B P B O N B O
L P B O B N N O
L B P O B B N O

questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a22e849294f30f1c26ce29433dfdc070bc3ce4277a615992ef818dd930b88c5a.png] 

**Given series**: P _ _ O N _ L B _ N P L _ O _ P L _ _ N

Let's check each Option One by One.

**Option 1) L B P O B N B O**

P **L** **B** O N / **P** L B **O** N / P L **B** O **N** / P L **B** **O** N → Follows a pattern of **PLBON.**

Option 2) L B P B O N B O 

P **L** **B** O N / **P** L B **B** N / P L **O** O **N /** P L **B** **O** N → Does not follow pattern.

Option 3) L P B O B N N O

P **L** **P** O N / **B** L B **O** N / P L **B** O **N** / P L **N** **O** N → Does not follow pattern.

Option 4) L B P O B B N O 

P **L** **B** O N / **P** L B **O** N / P L **B** O **B /** P L **N** **O** N → Does not follow pattern.

Hence, The correct answer is **"Option 1"**

questions.question:
Select the option that represents the letters that, when sequentially placed in the blanks below, will complete the letter-series.

a, b, a, b, b, _, a, b, a, b, _, a, a, b, a, b, b, _
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is: The set of letters "a, b, a, b, b, a" is being repeated.

Given Sequence: a, b, a, b, b, _, a, b, a, b, _, a, a, b, a, b, b, _

Now, putting the letters in the blank spaces given in the option one by one:

Option 1: b, a, b → a b a b b __b__/ a b a b __a __a/ a b a b b __b__

**Option 2: a, b, a → a b a b b __a__/ a b a b __b__ a/ a b a b b __a__**

option 3: b, b, b → a b a b b __b__/ a b a b __b__ a/ a b a b b __b__

Option 4: a, a, a → a b a b b __a__/ a b a b __a____ __a/ a b a b b __a__

Here, 'Option 2' followed a pattern.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".
